name: Punctured-Triangle Top-Cap Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $X=\{a,b,c,x\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$ with $W\ne\varnothing$, and let $\mathcal L_\triangle=\{\{a\},\{b\},\{a,b\},\{a,c\},\{b,c\},\{a,b,c\}\}$. Delete $\mathcal L_\triangle$, the fixed states $\{a,x\}$ and $\{a,c,x\}$, and the top cap $\{\{a,b,c\}\cup S:S\subseteq W\}$ from $2^X$. Attach a new pendant coordinate $f$ at the empty endpoint of the resulting base.
parameters: $d=|X|\ge5$ and $W\ne\varnothing$. The pendant family has $2^d-2^{|W|}-6$ states.
canonical_form: The cap is anchored at the three-coordinate top $\{a,b,c\}$ of the punctured triangle, while the coordinate $x$ supplies the two fixed local decorations.
recognition: A construction certificate verifies the valid base root $\{a,b,c,x\}$, the exact holes at $\varnothing$ and $X$, and repair sets $\{a,b,c,x\}$ and $W$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
